label: TP
reason: Both alerts are True Positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input from getParameter flows through doSomething via param->a53479->StringBuilder->HashMap->substring->Base64 encode/decode->split(' ')[0]->thing.doSomething()->bar, then bar is used in response.getWriter().format(bar,obj) which writes to HTTP response. The transformation chain (especially split(' ')[0]) does not fully sanitize inputs without spaces, leaving XSS risk. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): Same flow shows user-controlled bar used as format string in Writer.format(), creating format string vulnerability. Data flow analysis confirms taint reaches sink expression in both cases.

evidence.note: User input from getParameter flows through doSomething to bar, which is used in response.getWriter().format(bar,obj) - taint reaches sink
Transformation chain (StringBuilder, HashMap, substring, Base64, split) processes param but split(' ')[0] leaves pre-space content intact, allowing XSS/format string injection
